speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing a psychiatric condition alongside a new movement disorder. To begin, can you describe the specific movement symptoms you are noticing, such as tremors, stiffness, or involuntary movements?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced parkinsonism (secondary to risperidone use for schizophrenia).
